1431 is not a leap year (divisible by 3 in the Islamic calendar? Wait, the Gregorian calendar rule: leap if divisible by 4, but not by 100 unless divisible by 400. 1431 is not divisible by 4, so not leap).  
But the date given is 02-17-1431 in Gregorian? No, likely Gregorian date format MM-DD-YYYY: February 17, 1431.  
Add 9 months: November 17, 1431.  
Add 26 days: November has 30 days, so 17 + 26 = 43 → 43 - 30 = 13, so December 13, 1431.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1431-12-13
